name: Kinetic Subdivision
author: Echo Opera
description: Ten image and video subdivision treatments with custom motion, layout, sampling, edge and focal controls.

styles.name: Kinetic Treemap
styles.blurb: Nested cells drift smoothly over a shifting image.

inputs.label: Source image or video
inputs.hint: Attach a photo or clip; without one, the procedural source remains.

params.label: Treatment ID
params.hint: The treatment selected by this style; keep it fixed to preserve the preset.

params.label: Smoothness
params.hint: Fraction of each cycle spent easing into the next layout.

params.label: Source image
params.hint: Blend the attached media with the procedural source.

params.label: Topology hold
params.hint: Number of motion cycles before the partition layout evolves.

params.label: Focal protection
params.hint: Preserve the image around the focal point.

params.label: Split bias
params.hint: Push cut lines toward one side of each cell.

params.label: Displacement axis
params.hint: Constrain tile movement to a direction or radial projection.

params.label: Focal point X
params.hint: Drag the XY point onto the area to keep recognizable.

params.label: Focal point Y
params.hint: Drag the XY point onto the area to keep recognizable.

params.label: Edge color R
params.hint: Color of subdivision strokes; gutters still use background ink.

params.label: Edge color G
params.hint: Color of subdivision strokes; gutters still use background ink.

params.label: Edge color B
params.hint: Color of subdivision strokes; gutters still use background ink.

params.label: Echo length
params.hint: Spread the layered copies in Afterimage Atlas.

params.label: Color separation
params.hint: Offset red and blue channels in Chromatic Register.
